quizzes.question: What is a harness, in the sense of using coding agents?
options: The model vendor’s latest flagship SKU
The loop around the model: constitution, source of truth, injector, machine, verifier, and bounds
A multi-agent swarm that writes the spec for you
The Cloud Agent VM, and nothing else
quizzes.explanation: The model is not the product. The harness is how the agent works without rediscovering your system every session.

quizzes.question: In this workbook, an agent needs to fix a sentence in Chapter 1. What should it do?
options: Open constants.ts and edit the string in place
Edit chapters/ch1-landscape.md, then run node scripts/inject-chapter.mjs ch1
Paste the whole constants.ts into chat so it has full context
Migrate the bundler first so the sentence renders correctly
quizzes.explanation: Source is the markdown. The injector is the only path into the live artifact. Dumping the blob is context rot.

quizzes.question: When should you grant an agent real autonomy?
options: Always — autonomy is the point
Never — review every token
When you can name a verifier that defines done; otherwise stay in the loop
Whenever the task is important
quizzes.explanation: Without a verifier, done means the model said it was done. Autonomy is a per-task privilege.

quizzes.question: A teammate wants High Fast Cloud Agent for a title tweak. What do you do?
options: Use the expensive loop — more thinking is always better
Use a tight bot or in-editor agent; reserve Cloud Agent + High Fast for a hard rewrite
Start five agents in the same working tree so one of them is cheap
Skip the constitution so the agent can move faster
quizzes.explanation: Match the loop to the job. High Fast on a title change is how you empty a usage pool.

quizzes.question: What is the production minimum when an agent has tools?
options: Trust the system prompt
Read-only prod by default, no secrets in the thread, human-gated migrations, and a blast radius you can explain
Give it admin so it can finish the job
Only allow agents in greenfield repos
quizzes.explanation: If you cannot explain the blast radius of the tools you attached, the design is unfinished.

flashcards.back: The loop around the model: constitution, source, injector, machine, verifier, bounds. The model is not the product.
A one-page AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / rules file: purpose, stack, landmines, how to change a file.
The only path from editable source into the live artifact. In this repo: node scripts/inject-chapter.mjs chN.
The agent optimized for looking finished — weakened tests, hardcoded fixtures — instead of meeting the verifier.
The definition of done the agent can run: tests, types, build, evals. Without one, do not grant autonomy.
A dirty thread where contradictory instructions accumulate and the agent ‘simplifies’ away an early constraint.
Bot/Composer for copy and chrome. Cloud Agent for one rewrite + branch + PR. High Fast is not for title tweaks.
The human or gate that decides the work is actually done. An agent without a closer is faster drift.
